text:
```yaml
name: Cleanup Preview Branches

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]

jobs:
  cleanup_preview_branch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Configure environment variables
        env:
          NEON_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEON_API_KEY }}
          DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED: ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED }}
          NEON_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.NEON_PROJECT_ID }}
        run: echo "export NEON_API_KEY=$NEON_API_KEY" >> $GITHUB_ENV && echo "export DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=$DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED" >> $GITHUB_ENV && echo "export NEON_PROJECT_ID=$NEON_PROJECT_ID" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Clean up Neon branch
        run: npx neon-cli db drop --confirm
```
